question: My LDAP is not working and I cannot access the internet or WiFi.
answer: Your LDAP account might be expired. To renew it, please send your valid ID card to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in.

question: My WiFi is not working, I am a project staff.
answer: Since you are project staff, your LDAP likely expired. Please send an extension letter from your PI to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in to renew your access.

question: My internet is down, I am a student.
answer: Your student LDAP account may have expired. Please ask your academic section to send an approval letter to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in to renew it.

question: IMail is not working.
answer: IMail issues are treated the same as LDAP. Your account is likely expired. Please send your valid ID card to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in for renewal.

question: IMail not working, I am project staff.
answer: Please send an extension letter from your guide to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in to renew your IMail/LDAP access.

question: SMail is not working.
answer: If your SMail is not working, please send an email to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in requesting them to add your account to the SMail group.

question: How do I reset my LDAP password?
answer: You can instantly reset your LDAP password by visiting this link: https://ldap.iitm.ac.in/

question: I need a new LDAP account, I am an intern.
answer: Interns and project staff can register for a new LDAP account using this link: https://web.iitm.ac.in/ldaponline/

question: How to get a new IMail account for project staff?
answer: Project staff and interns must register for an IMail account through the online portal: https://web.iitm.ac.in/ldaponline/

question: Create an LDAP account for me, I am a student.
answer: Student LDAP and SMail accounts cannot be requested directly by the student. They are created only if the request is sent by the academic section.

question: I am a student and I need SMail access.
answer: Student SMail accounts are created only if the request is sent by your academic section to the Computer Center.

question: I am a permanent staff or faculty and need a new LDAP or Zmail account.
answer: Permanent staff and faculty should register for LDAP/Zmail accounts using this link: https://web.iitm.ac.in/emailonline/

question: How do I get my LDAP credentials?
answer: If you need your credentials or something is wrong with your account, please send your ID card to the helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in email.

question: My account is locked or blocked.
answer: If your account is locked or something is wrong, please email your valid ID card to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in.

question: I forgot my LDAP username.
answer: To retrieve your credentials or fix account issues, please send your valid ID card to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in.

question: Can you create an LDAP account for me right now?
answer: I cannot create accounts directly. Students must get it via the Academic section. Project staff/interns use https://web.iitm.ac.in/ldaponline/ and faculty use https://web.iitm.ac.in/emailonline/.

question: I am a new faculty member, how do I get email?
answer: Permanent faculty members should register for their official email/Zmail/LDAP account here: https://web.iitm.ac.in/emailonline/

question: How do I extend my project staff LDAP?
answer: To extend a project staff account, you must send an official extension letter from your Principal Investigator to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in.

question: Where should I send my ID card for LDAP issues?
answer: For any LDAP credential issues, expired accounts, or locked accounts, please send your valid ID card to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in.

question: My WiFi is not working, I am a research scholar.
answer: Your research scholar LDAP account may have expired. Please ask your academic/research section to send an approval letter to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in to renew it.

question: My WiFi is not connecting, I am faculty.
answer: Faculty WiFi issues are usually linked to LDAP account expiry or a credential mismatch. Please email helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in for assistance.

question: My Zmail is not working.
answer: Zmail issues are treated the same as LDAP. Your account is likely expired. Please send an email to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in for renewal.

question: My Zmail is not working, I am faculty.
answer: If you are permanent faculty and your Zmail is not working, please send an email to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in for renewal.

question: How do I reset my IMail password?
answer: IMail does not have a self-service reset option. Please send an email to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in requesting a password reset for your IMail account.

question: How do I reset my SMail password?
answer: SMail does not have a self-service reset option. Please send an email to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in requesting a password reset for your SMail account.

question: I need a new LDAP account, I am a visiting researcher.
answer: Visiting researchers, interns, and project staff can register for a new LDAP account using this link: https://web.iitm.ac.in/ldaponline/

question: How to get a new Zmail account for faculty?
answer: Permanent staff and faculty should register for LDAP/Zmail accounts using this link: https://web.iitm.ac.in/emailonline/

question: Create an SMail account for me, I am a student.
answer: Student SMail accounts cannot be requested directly by the student. They are created only if the request is sent by your academic section to the Computer Center.

question: I am a research scholar and need SMail access.
answer: Research scholar SMail accounts are created only if the request is sent by your academic/research section to the Computer Center.

question: How do I get my IMail credentials?
answer: If you need your IMail credentials or something is wrong with your account, please send an email to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in or register through https://web.iitm.ac.in/ldaponline/

question: My Zmail account is locked.
answer: If your Zmail account is locked or something is wrong, please email your valid ID card to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in.

question: I forgot my IMail username.
answer: To retrieve your IMail credentials or fix account issues, please send your valid ID card to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in.

question: Can you create a Zmail account for me right now?
answer: I cannot create accounts directly. Project staff/interns should register at https://web.iitm.ac.in/ldaponline/ and faculty/permanent staff should register at https://web.iitm.ac.in/emailonline/.

question: I am a new project staff member, how do I get email?
answer: New project staff and interns should register for their IMail/LDAP account here: https://web.iitm.ac.in/ldaponline/

question: How do I extend my intern LDAP account?
answer: To extend an intern account, you must send an official extension letter from your supervisor/PI to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in.

question: Where should I send my ID card for IMail issues?
answer: For any IMail credential issues, expired accounts, or locked accounts, please send your valid ID card to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in.

question: My WiFi is not working, I am a permanent staff member.
answer: Permanent staff accounts don't usually expire the same way project/student accounts do. Please send an email to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in so your account status can be checked.

question: How do I renew my visiting faculty LDAP account?
answer: To renew a visiting faculty account, please send an official extension/appointment letter from your host department to helpdeskeservices@iitm.ac.in, or register at https://web.iitm.ac.in/emailonline/.
